basic_profile.bio: A passionate Rice University alumnus currently residing in Houston, Texas. I work as a software developer for a mid-sized tech firm. I spend most of my online hours in the evenings, usually after 7 PM. I have a Doberman Pinscher named Duke and enjoy playing Minecraft in my free time. I'm single and enjoy discussing college football and tech trends. I dislike internet trolls and people who spoil entertainment content.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from Rice University. My expertise is mainly in software development, particularly in Python and Java. I am an avid learner, often staying updated with the latest tech trends through online courses and tech forums.
